finding.title: Valid JSONL out-of-range effective timestamp gives concrete external_jsonl trigger for partial archive admission
finding.mechanism: JsonlFlowAdapter.collect parses both syntactically valid JSONL rows with FlowObservation.from_dict. The contract casts effective_at_ms to int but does not enforce datetime representability; the archive's _semantic_signature and observation_id accept 1000000000000000000. During append_observations, row G1 is written first, then G2.to_dict calls ms_to_iso(1000000000000000000), where datetime.fromtimestamp(..., tz=UTC) raises ValueError for an out-of-range year. runner.run_once appends before loading history and before writing latest.json/audit_latest.json/anata_latest.json.
